label: übernehmen

edition.check: Level 5: requires an input barcode match in >=2 sources. NOT MET: the input has no barcode and the tape has none (MB search: 'Barcode -'; all Discogs entries 'Barcodes -'). Level 4, without barcode: title, artist and format must be unambiguous in >=2 sources. MET: MB 19fd3695 lists Cassette, Bushido, King of Kingz; Discogs 1951581 lists Cassette, Bushido (2), King Of Kingz; musik-sammler 917995 lists Tape. At least one further attribute must also agree. MET: label I Luv Money Records and year 2001 in MB, Discogs and musik-sammler. No fitting edition may have a different tracklist. MET: all 6 cassette versions in Discogs master 211928 (1951581, 18354001, 18354166, 18354289, 17280904, 4256710) were fetched and share 16 identical tracks and durations; the CD editions in tl-search are excluded by the input format. The 'Demotape (Extended Version)' snippet on musik-sammler also lists 16 tracks for Tape 2001. Stop at 4.
edition.summary: Title, artist, cassette format, label and year agree across MusicBrainz, Discogs and musik-sammler, and all six known cassette pressings share an identical 16-track list, so the choice of pressing does not matter.

tracklist.check: Level 5: >=2 independent sources of the same edition must agree on count, order and titles. MET: MB 19fd3695, Discogs 1951581 and musik-sammler 917995 all give 16 tracks in the same A1–B8 order with identical durations (total 49:39). Title differences are spelling variants only: MB has 'Nute Bounce', 'Pitbull', 'Hast du Mut'; musik-sammler has 'Vack You!'. The sources are recognisably independent because their spellings and feature credits differ. Stop at 5.
tracklist.summary: Three independent sources agree exactly on 16 tracks, their order and their durations, differing only in spelling.

durations.check: 100% of tracks have a duration, 100% confirmed by >= 2 sources, 0 conflicts
durations.summary: 100% of tracks have a duration, 100% confirmed by >= 2 sources, 0 conflicts

sources.check: Level 5: requires a database plus an independent primary source of the same edition. NOT MET: the Discogs-hosted J-card and tape-label images were read via tl-vision but show no tracklist, so they confirm only label and year, not content. They are also hosted on the same Discogs entry. Level 4: two independent database entries, or a database plus a specialised collector site. MET: MusicBrainz and Discogs differ in spellings and cat. no. format, and musik-sammler.de adds a collector-site confirmation. Stop at 4.
sources.summary: Two independent databases plus musik-sammler.de support the result, but no primary source shows the printed tracklist.

concerns: Cat. no. 'ILM 003' is taken from MB only; Discogs gives '03' and the J-card spine reads 'ILM1' (tl-vision step 8). This was not flagged as a conflict.

Matching the MB release and the musik-sammler 'Limited Edition' entry specifically to the Discogs first edition 1951581 is not evidenced, since neither distinguishes pressings. This is harmless here because the tracklists are identical.
A8 featured artists 'Bass Sultan Hengzt & King Orgasmus One' come from MB only; musik-sammler names 'Baktus & Orgasmus', and the Discogs output shows no track artists.
Title spellings at A6, B3 and B6 follow Discogs/musik-sammler, while MB differs ('Nute Bounce', 'Pitbull', 'Hast du Mut'). These are minor variants and are not recorded in conflicts.
Discogs 1951581 labels its sides 'Side B' and 'Side U' (matching the tape stickers), yet the positions are given as A/B. This is an inconsistency in the source.
